title: Hydronic Piping
body: User notes:About this chapter: Chapter 21 is specific to hydronic piping, which includes steam, hot water and ground-source heat-pump system loop piping. This chapter addresses piping materials, joining methods, support, protection of the structure, testing, protection of potable water and general installation requirements.Code development reminder: Code change proposals to this chapter will be considered by the IRC—Plumbing/Mechanical Code Development Committee during the 2021 (Group A) Code Development Cycle.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: General
body: Hydronic piping shall conform to Table M2101.1. Approved piping, valves, fittings and connections shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions. Pipe and fittings shall be rated for use at the operating temperature and pressure of the hydronic system. section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: System Drain Down
body: Hydronic piping systems shall be installed to permit draining of the system. Where the system drains to the plumbing drainage system, the installation shall conform to the requirements of Chapters 25 through 32 of this code.Exception: The buried portions of systems embedded underground or under floors.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Protection of Potable Water
body: The potable water system shall be protected from backflow in accordance with the provisions listed in Section P2902.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Pipe Penetrations
body: Openings through concrete or masonry building elements shall be sleeved.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Contact With Building Material
body: A hydronic piping system shall not be in direct contact with any building material that causes the piping material to degrade or corrode.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Drilling and Notching
body: Wood-framed structural members shall be drilled, notched or altered in accordance with the provisions of Sections R502.8, R602.6, R602.6.1 and R802.7. Holes in load-bearing members of cold-formed steel light-frame construction shall be permitted only in accordance with Sections R505.2.6, R603.2.6 and R804.2.6. In accordance with the provisions of Sections R505.3.5, R603.3.4 and R804.3.3, cutting and notching of flanges and lips of load-bearing members of cold-formed steel light-frame construction shall not be permitted. Structural insulated panels (SIPs) shall be drilled and notched or altered in accordance with the provisions of Section R610.7.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Prohibited Tee Applications
body: Fluid in the supply side of a hydronic system shall not enter a tee fitting through the branch opening.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Expansion, Contraction and Settlement
body: Piping shall be installed so that piping, connections and equipment shall not be subjected to excessive strains or stresses. Provisions shall be made to compensate for expansion, contraction, shrinkage and structural settlement.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Piping Support
body: Hangers and supports shall be of material of sufficient strength to support the piping, and shall be fabricated from materials compatible with the piping material. Piping shall be supported at intervals not exceeding the spacing specified in Table M2101.9.TABLE M2101.9HANGER SPACING INTERVALSPIPING MATERIALMAXIMUM HORIZONTAL SPACING (feet)MAXIMUM VERTICAL SPACING (feet)ABS410aCPVC ≤ 1-inch pipe or tubing35aCPVC ≥ 11/4 inches410aCopper or copper-alloy pipe1210Copper or copper-alloy tubing610PB pipe or tubing2.674PE pipe or tubing2.674PE-RT ≤ 1 inch2.6710aPE-RT ≥ 11/4 inches410aPEX tubing ≤ 1 inch2.674PEX tubing ≥ 11/4 inches410aPP < 1-inch pipe or tubing2.674PP > 11/4 inches410aPVC410aSteel pipe1215Steel tubing810For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm, 1 foot = 304.8 mm.For sizes 2 inches and smaller, a guide shall be installed midway between required vertical supports. section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Tests
body: Hydronic piping systems shall be tested hydrostatically at a pressure of one and one-half times the maximum system design pressure, but not less than 100 pounds per square inch (689 kPa). The duration of each test shall be not less than 15 minutes.Exception: For PEX piping systems, testing with a compressed gas shall be an alternative to hydrostatic testing where compressed air or other gas pressure testing is specifically authorized by all of the manufacturers' instructions for the PEX pipe and fittings products installed at the time the system is being tested, and compressed air or other gas testing is not otherwise prohibited by applicable codes, laws, or regulations outside of this code.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Used Materials
body: Used pipe, fittings, valves and other materials shall not be reused in hydronic systems.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Material Rating
body: Pipe and tubing shall be rated for the operating temperature and pressure of the system. Fittings shall be suitable for the pressure applications and recommended by the manufacturer for use with the pipe and tubing material installed. Where used underground, materials shall be suitable for burial.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Joints and Connections
body: Joints and connections shall be of an approved type. Joints and connections shall be tight for the pressure of the system. Joints used underground shall be approved for such applications.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Joints Between Different Piping Materials
body: Joints between different piping materials shall be made with approved transition fittings.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Preparation of Pipe Ends
body: Pipe shall be cut square and shall be free of burrs and obstructions. Pipe ends shall have full-bore openings and shall be prepared in accordance with the pipe manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Joint Preparation and Installation
body: Where required by Sections M2101.16 through M2101.18, the preparation and installation of mechanical and thermoplastic-welded joints shall comply with Sections M2101.15.1 and M2101.15.2.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Mechanical Joints
body: Mechanical joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Thermoplastic-Welded Joints
body: Joint surfaces for thermoplastic-welded joints shall be cleaned by an approved procedure. Joints shall be welded in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: CPVC Plastic Pipe
body: Joints between CPVC plastic pipe or fittings shall be solvent cemented in accordance with Section P2906.9.1.2. Threaded joints between fittings and CPVC plastic pipe shall be in accordance with Section M2101.16.1.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Threaded Joints
body: Threads shall conform to ASME B1.20.1 The pipe shall be Schedule 80, 40 or heavier plastic pipe and shall be threaded with dies specifically designed for plastic pipe. Thread lubricant, pipe-joint compound or tape shall be applied on the male threads only and shall be approved for application on the piping material.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Cross-Linked Polyethylene (PEX) Plastic Tubing
body: Joints between cross-linked polyethylene plastic tubing and fittings shall comply with Sections M2101.17.1 and M2101.17.2. Mechanical joints shall comply with Section M2101.15.1.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Compression-Type Fittings
body: Where compression-type fittings include inserts and ferrules or O-rings, the fittings shall be installed without omitting the inserts and ferrules or O-rings.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Plastic-to-Metal
body: Solder joints in a metal pipe shall not occur within 18 inches (457 mm) of a transition from such metal pipe to plastic pipe or tubing.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Polyethylene Plastic Pipe and Tubing
body: Joints between polyethylene plastic pipe and tubing or fittings for systems shall be heat-fusion joints complying with Section M2101.18.1, electrofusion joints complying with Section M2101.18.2, or stab-type insertion joints complying with Section M2101.18.3.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Heat-Fusion Joints
body: Joints shall be of the socket-fusion, saddle-fusion or butt-fusion type, and joined in accordance with ASTM D2657. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures and joined. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM D2683 or ASTM D3261.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Electrofusion Joints
body: Joints shall be of the electrofusion type. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture, and scoured to expose virgin resin. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures for the period of time specified by the manufacturer. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM F1055.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Stab-Type Insert Fittings
body: Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. Pipe ends shall be chamfered and inserted into the fittings to full depth. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM F1924.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Polypropylene (PP) Plastic
body: Joints between PP plastic pipe and fittings shall comply with Sections M2101.19.1 and M2101.19.2.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Heat-Fusion Joints
body: Heat-fusion joints for polypropylene (PP) pipe and tubing joints shall be installed with socket-type heat-fused polypropylene fittings, electrofusion polypropylene fittings or by butt fusion. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Joints shall be made in accordance with ASTM F2389.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Mechanical and Compression Sleeve Joints
body: Mechanical and compression sleeve joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Raised Temperature Polyethylene (PE-RT) Plastic Tubing
body: Joints between raised temperature polyethylene tubing and fittings shall comply with Sections M2101.20.1 through M2101.20.4. Mechanical joints shall comply with Section M2101.15.1.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Compression-Type Fittings
body: Where compression-type fittings include inserts and ferrules or O-rings, the fittings shall be installed without omitting the inserts and ferrules or O-rings.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: PE-RT-to-Metal Connections
body: Solder joints in a metal pipe shall not occur within 18 inches (457 mm) of a transition from such metal pipe to PE-RT pipe or tubing.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Heat-Fusion Joints
body: Heat-fusion joints shall be of the socket-fusion, saddle-fusion or butt-fusion type, and shall be joined in accordance with ASTM D2657. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures and joined. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM D2683 or ASTM D3261.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Electrofusion Joints
body: Joints shall be of the electrofusion type. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture and scoured to expose virgin resin. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures for the period of time specified by the manufacturer and joined. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM F1055.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: PVC Plastic Pipe
body: Joints between PVC plastic pipe or fittings shall be solvent cemented in accordance with Section P2906.9.1.4. Threaded joints between fittings and PVC plastic pipe shall be in accordance with Section M2101.16.1.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Shutoff Valves
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed in ground-source loop piping systems in the locations indicated in Sections M2101.22.1 through M2101.22.6.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Heat Exchangers
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on the supply and return sides of a heat exchanger. Exception: Shutoff valves shall not be required where heat exchangers are integral with a boiler or are a component of a manufacturer's boiler and heat exchanger packaged unit and are capable of being isolated from the hydronic system by the supply and return valves required by Section M2001.3.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Central Systems
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on the building supply and return of a central utility system.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Pressure Vessels
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on the connection to any pressure vessel.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Pressure-Reducing Valves
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on both sides of a pressure-reducing valve.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Equipment and Appliances
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on connections to mechanical equipment and appliances. This requirement does not apply to components of ground-source loop systems such as pumps, air separators, metering devices, and similar equipment.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Expansion Tanks
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed at connections to nondiaphragm-type expansion tanks.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Reduced Pressure
body: A pressure relief valve shall be installed on the low-pressure side of a hydronic piping system that has been reduced in pressure. The relief valve shall be set at the maximum pressure of the system design. The valve shall be installed in accordance with Section M2002.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Installation
body: Piping, valves, fittings and connections shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Protection of Potable Water
body: Where hydronic systems have a connection to a potable water supply, the potable water system shall be protected from backflow in accordance with Section P2902.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Pipe Penetrations
body: Openings for pipe penetrations in walls, floors and ceilings shall be larger than the penetrating pipe. Openings through concrete or masonry building elements shall be sleeved. The annular space surrounding pipe penetrations shall be protected in accordance with Section P2606.1.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Clearance From Combustibles
body: A pipe in a piping system having an exterior surface temperature exceeding 250°F (121°C) shall have a clearance of not less than 1 inch (25 mm) from combustible materials.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Contact With Building Material
body: A piping system shall not be in direct contact with building materials that cause the piping or fitting material to degrade or corrode, or that interfere with the operation of the system.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Strains and Stresses
body: Piping shall be installed so as to prevent detrimental strains and stresses in the pipe. Provisions shall be made to protect piping from damage resulting from expansion, contraction and structural settlement. Piping shall be installed so as to avoid structural stresses or strains within building components.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Flood Hazard
body: Piping located in a flood hazard area shall be capable of resisting hydrostatic and hydrodynamic loads and stresses, including the effects of buoyancy, during the occurrence of flooding to the design flood elevation.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Chemical Compatibility
body: Antifreeze and other materials used in the system shall be chemically compatible with the pipe, tubing, fittings and mechanical systems.

section: Section M2101 Hydronic Piping Systems Installation
title: Makeup Water
body: The transfer fluid shall be compatible with the makeup water supplied to the system.

section: Section M2102 Baseboard Convectors
title: General
body: Baseboard convectors shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions. Convectors shall be supported independently of the hydronic piping.

section: Section M2103 Floor Heating Systems
title: Piping Materials
body: Piping for embedment in concrete or gypsum materials shall be standard-weight steel pipe, copper and copper-alloy pipe and tubing, cross-linked polyethylene/aluminum/cross-linked polyethylene (PEX-AL-PEX) pressure pipe, chlorinated polyvinyl chloride (CPVC), cross-linked polyethylene (PEX) tubing, polyethylene of raised temperature (PE-RT) or polypropylene (PP) with a rating of not less than 80 pounds per square inch at 180°F (552 kPa at 82°C).

section: Section M2103 Floor Heating Systems
title: Thermal Barrier Required
body: Radiant floor heating systems shall have a thermal barrier in accordance with Sections M2103.2.1 and M2103.2.2. Insulation R-values for slab-on-grade and suspended floor installations shall be in accordance with Chapter 11.Exception: Insulation shall not be required in engineered systems where it can be demonstrated that the insulation will decrease the efficiency or have a negative effect on the installation.

section: Section M2103 Floor Heating Systems
title: Thermal Break Required
body: A thermal break consisting of asphalt expansion joint materials or similar insulating materials shall be provided at a point where a heated slab meets a foundation wall or other conductive slab.

section: Section M2103 Floor Heating Systems
title: Thermal Barrier Material Marking
body: Insulating materials used in thermal barriers shall be installed so that the manufacturer's R-value mark is readily observable upon inspection.

section: Section M2103 Floor Heating Systems
title: Piping Joints
body: Copper and copper-alloy systems shall be soldered, brazed, or press connected. Soldering shall be in accordance with ASTM B828. Fluxes for soldering shall be in accordance with ASTM B813. Brazing fluxes shall be in accordance with AWS A5.31. Press-connect joints shall be in accordance with ASME B16.51. Piping joints that are embedded shall be installed in accordance with the following requirements:Steel pipe joints shall be welded.Copper tubing shall be joined by brazing complying with Section P3003.6.1.Polybutylene pipe and tubing joints shall be installed with socket-type heat-fused polybutylene fittings.CPVC tubing shall be joined using solvent cement joints.Polypropylene pipe and tubing joints shall be installed with socket-type heat-fused polypropylene fittings.Cross-linked polyethylene (PEX) tubing shall be joined using cold expansion, insert or compression fittings.Raised temperature polyethylene (PE-RT) tubing shall be joined using insert or compression fittings.

section: Section M2103 Floor Heating Systems
title: Testing
body: Piping or tubing to be embedded shall be tested by applying a hydrostatic pressure of not less than 100 psi (690 kPa). The pressure shall be maintained for 30 minutes, during which the joints shall be visually inspected for leaks.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: Piping Materials
body: Low temperature piping for embedment in concrete or gypsum materials shall be as indicated in Table M2101.1.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: Piping Joints
body: Piping joints that are embedded, other than those in Section M2103.3, shall comply with the following requirements:Cross-linked polyethylene (PEX) tubing shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.Polyethylene tubing shall be installed with heat-fusion joints.Polypropylene (PP) tubing shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.Raised temperature polyethylene (PE-RT) shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: Raised Temperature Polyethylene (PE-RT) Plastic Tubing
body: Joints between raised temperature polyethylene tubing and fittings shall conform to Sections M2104.3.1 through M2104.3.3. Mechanical joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: Compression-Type Fittings
body: Where compression-type fittings include inserts and ferrules or O-rings, the fittings shall be installed without omitting such inserts and ferrules or O-rings.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: PE-RT-to-Metal Connections
body: Solder joints in a metal pipe shall not occur within 18 inches (457 mm) of a transition from such metal pipe to PE-RT pipe.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: PE-RT Insert Fittings
body: PE-RT insert fittings shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: Polyethylene/Aluminum/Polyethylene (PE-AL-PE) Pressure Pipe
body: Joints between polyethylene/aluminum/polyethylene pressure pipe and fittings shall conform to Sections M2104.4.1 and M2104.4.2. Mechanical joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: Compression-Type Fittings
body: Where compression-type fittings include inserts and ferrules or O-rings, the fittings shall be installed without omitting such inserts and ferrules or O-rings.

section: Section M2104 Low Temperature Piping
title: PE-AL-PE-to-metal Connections
body: Solder joints in a metal pipe shall not occur within 18 inches (457 mm) of a transition from such metal pipe to PE-AL-PE pipe.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Plastic Ground-Source Heat-Pump Loop Piping
body: Plastic piping and tubing material used in water-based ground-source heat-pump ground-loop systems shall conform to the standards specified in this section.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Used Materials
body: Reused pipe, fittings, valves, and other materials shall not be used in ground-source heat-pump loop systems.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Material Rating
body: Pipe and tubing shall be rated for the operating temperature and pressure of the ground-source heat-pump loop system. Fittings shall be suitable for the pressure applications and recommended by the manufacturer for installation with the pipe and tubing material installed. Where used underground, materials shall be suitable for burial.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Joints and Connections
body: Joints and connections shall be of an approved type. Joints and connections shall be tight for the pressure of the ground-source loop system. Joints used underground shall be approved for such applications.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Joints Between Different Piping Materials
body: Joints between different piping materials shall be made with approved transition fittings.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Preparation of Pipe Ends
body: Pipe shall be cut square and shall be free of burrs and obstructions. Pipe ends shall have full-bore openings and shall be prepared in accordance with the pipe manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Joint Preparation and Installation
body: Where required by Sections M2105.9 through M2105.11, the preparation and installation of mechanical and thermoplastic-welded joints shall comply with Sections M2105.8.1 and M2105.8.2.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Mechanical Joints
body: Mechanical joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Thermoplastic-Welded Joints
body: Joint surfaces for thermoplastic-welded joints shall be cleaned by an approved procedure. Joints shall be welded in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: CPVC Plastic Pipe
body: Joints between CPVC plastic pipe or fittings shall be solvent-cemented in accordance with Section P2906.9.1.2. Threaded joints between fittings and CPVC plastic pipe shall be in accordance with Section M2105.9.1.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Threaded Joints
body: Threads shall conform to ASME B1.20.1. The pipe shall be Schedule 80 or heavier plastic pipe and shall be threaded with dies specifically designed for plastic pipe. Thread lubricant, pipe-joint compound or tape shall be applied on the male threads only and shall be approved for application on the piping material.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Cross-Linked Polyethylene (PEX) Plastic Tubing
body: Joints between cross-linked polyethylene plastic tubing and fittings shall comply with Sections M2105.10.1 and M2105.10.2. Mechanical joints shall comply with Section M2105.8.1.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Compression-Type Fittings
body: Where compression-type fittings include inserts and ferrules or O-rings, the fittings shall be installed without omitting the inserts and ferrules or O-rings.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Plastic-to-Metal Connections
body: Solder joints in a metal pipe shall not occur within 18 inches (457 mm) of a transition from such metal pipe to plastic pipe or tubing.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Polyethylene Plastic Pipe and Tubing
body: Joints between polyethylene plastic pipe and tubing or fittings for ground-source heat-pump loop systems shall be heat-fusion joints complying with Section M2105.11.1, electrofusion joints complying with Section M2105.11.2, or stab-type insertion joints complying with Section M2105.11.3.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Heat-Fusion Joints
body: Joints shall be of the socket-fusion, saddle-fusion or butt-fusion type, and joined in accordance with ASTM D2657. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures and joined. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM D2683 or ASTM D3261.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Electrofusion Joints
body: Joints shall be of the electrofusion type. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture, and scoured to expose virgin resin. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures for the period of time specified by the manufacturer. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM F1055.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Stab-Type Insert Fittings
body: Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. Pipe ends shall be chamfered and inserted into the fittings to full depth. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM F1924.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Polypropylene (PP) Plastic
body: Joints between PP plastic pipe and fittings shall comply with Sections M2105.12.1 and M2105.12.2.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Heat-Fusion Joints
body: Heat-fusion joints for polypropylene (PP) pipe and tubing joints shall be installed with socket-type heat-fused polypropylene fittings, electrofusion polypropylene fittings or by butt fusion. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Joints shall be made in accordance with ASTM F2389.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Mechanical and Compression Sleeve Joints
body: Mechanical and compression sleeve joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Raised Temperature Polyethylene (PE-RT) Plastic Tubing
body: Joints between raised temperature polyethylene tubing and fittings shall comply with Sections M2105.13.1 through M2105.13.4. Mechanical joints shall comply with Section M2105.8.1.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Compression-Type Fittings
body: Where compression-type fittings include inserts and ferrules or O-rings, the fittings shall be installed without omitting the inserts and ferrules or O-rings.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: PE-RT-to-Metal Connections
body: Solder joints in a metal pipe shall not occur within 18 inches (457 mm) of a transition from such metal pipe to PE-RT pipe or tubing.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Heat-Fusion Joints
body: Heat-fusion joints shall be of the socket-fusion, saddle-fusion or butt-fusion type, and shall be joined in accordance with ASTM D2657. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures and joined. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM D2683 or ASTM D3261.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Electrofusion Joints
body: Joints shall be of the electrofusion type. Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture and scoured to expose virgin resin. Joint surfaces shall be heated to melt temperatures for the period of time specified by the manufacturer and joined. The joint shall remain undisturbed until cool. Fittings shall be manufactured in accordance with ASTM F1055.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: PVC Plastic Pipe
body: Joints between PVC plastic pipe or fittings shall be solvent-cemented in accordance with Section P2906.9.1.4. Threaded joints between fittings and PVC plastic pipe shall be in accordance with Section M2105.9.1.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Shutoff Valves
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed in ground-source loop piping systems in the locations indicated in Sections M2105.15.1 through M2105.15.6.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Heat Exchangers
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on the supply and return side of a heat exchanger.Exception: Shutoff valves shall not be required where heat exchangers are integral with a boiler or are a component of a manufacturer's boiler and heat exchanger packaged unit and are capable of being isolated from the hydronic system by the supply and return valves required by Section M2001.3.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Central Systems
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on the building supply and return of a central utility system.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Pressure Vessels
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on the connection to any pressure vessel.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Pressure-Reducing Valves
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on both sides of a pressure-reducing valve.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Equipment and Appliances
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed on connections to mechanical equipment and appliances. This requirement does not apply to components of ground-source loop systems such as pumps, air separators, metering devices, and similar equipment.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Expansion Tanks
body: Shutoff valves shall be installed at connections to nondiaphragm-type expansion tanks.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Reduced Pressure
body: A pressure relief valve shall be installed on the low-pressure side of a hydronic piping system that has been reduced in pressure. The relief valve shall be set at the maximum pressure of the system design. The valve shall be installed in accordance with Section M2002.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Installation
body: Piping, valves, fittings, and connections shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Protection of Potable Water
body: Where ground-source heat-pump ground-loop systems have a connection to a potable water supply, the potable water system shall be protected from backflow in accordance with Section P2902.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Pipe Penetrations
body: Openings for pipe penetrations in walls, floors and ceilings shall be larger than the penetrating pipe. Openings through concrete or masonry building elements shall be sleeved. The annular space surrounding pipe penetrations shall be protected in accordance with Section P2606.1.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Clearance From Combustibles
body: A pipe in a ground-source heat pump piping system having an exterior surface temperature exceeding 250°F (121°C) shall have a clearance of not less than 1 inch (25 mm) from combustible materials.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Contact With Building Material
body: A ground-source heat-pump ground-loop piping system shall not be in direct contact with building materials that cause the piping or fitting material to degrade or corrode, or that interfere with the operation of the system.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Strains and Stresses
body: Piping shall be installed so as to prevent detrimental strains and stresses in the pipe. Provisions shall be made to protect piping from damage resulting from expansion, contraction and structural settlement. Piping shall be installed so as to avoid structural stresses or strains within building components.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Flood Hazard
body: Piping located in a flood hazard area shall be capable of resisting hydrostatic and hydrodynamic loads and stresses, including the effects of buoyancy, during the occurrence of flooding to the design flood elevation.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Pipe Support
body: Pipe shall be supported in accordance with Section M2101.9.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Velocities
body: Ground-source heat-pump ground-loop systems shall be designed so that the flow velocities do not exceed the maximum flow velocity recommended by the pipe and fittings manufacturer. Flow velocities shall be controlled to reduce the possibility of water hammer.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Labeling and Marking
body: Ground-source heat-pump ground-loop system piping shall be marked with tape, metal tags or other methods where it enters a building. The marking shall state the following words: "GROUND-SOURCE HEAT-PUMP LOOP SYSTEM." The marking shall indicate if antifreeze is used in the system and shall indicate the chemicals by name and concentration.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Chemical Compatibility
body: Antifreeze and other materials used in the system shall be chemically compatible with the pipe, tubing, fittings and mechanical systems.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Makeup Water
body: The transfer fluid shall be compatible with the makeup water supplied to the system.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Testing
body: Before connection header trenches are backfilled, the assembled loop system shall be pressure tested with water at 100 psi (689 kPa) for 15 minutes without observed leaks. Flow and pressure loss testing shall be performed and the actual flow rates and pressure drops shall be compared to the calculated design values. If actual flow rate or pressure drop values differ from calculated design values by more than 10 percent, the cause shall be identified and corrective action taken.

section: Section M2105 Ground-Source Heat-Pump System Loop Piping
title: Embedded Piping
body: Ground-source heat-pump ground-loop piping to be embedded in concrete shall be pressure tested prior to pouring concrete. During pouring, the pipe shall be maintained at the proposed operating pressure.
